audit.why: 53.25% over 1001 games sits against a chart that gives Lucian levels 1-3 and both item stages and Camille only the Skill stages at 4-5 and 6. The stage split is defensible on kit - he out-ranges her until Hookshot exists and out-spaces her again once he has items - so I moved no sides or ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: His first-item spike was described as 'E + Galeforce-style mobility' - an item that is not part of the kit data and a second dash he does not have. The real spike detail is that Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown, so his effective dash uptime scales with his attack speed and his ability to keep hitting you.
audit.why: Riot, Relentless Pursuit: 'Lucian quickly dashes a short distance. Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.' Base cooldown 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s per champ-data/_kits/lucian.json.
audit.corrected: spikes[3].text and late now name the real mechanism - Lightslinger hits shaving a 16s dash - instead of inventing a second dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors and one big omission. (1) 'his E dash and Relentless Pursuit' / 'he can't E-dash or Relentless-Pursuit out' treats them as two abilities in four places - Relentless Pursuit IS his E, so the page reads as though he has double the escape he owns. (2) Lightslinger is described as a permanent double-shot; it only arms after he casts an ability, is healed or shielded, or a nearby enemy is IMMOBILIZED - which means your own Hookshot knock-up hands him the empowered shots. (3) Camille's passive is spelled 'Adaptive Defense' twice; it is Adaptive Defenses. Hookshot is called a stun; Riot's text says knock-up.
audit.why: Riot, Lightslinger: 'Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot. When Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks...' Relentless Pursuit is his E. Hookshot: 'leaping off and knocking up enemy champions upon landing.' _missing-interactions.json flags autoreset-burst-tell and needs-antiheal for this pairing.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text, mid, whys[4] and wants.foe[1] now name Relentless Pursuit as his one dash; early and whys[3] state that your knock-up itself arms Lightslinger, so the shield has to be up when you engage.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Force the all-in while his E is down' had no duration, and the thing that makes the window unreliable - that he shortens it by hitting you - was never said.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1 but every Lightslinger attack cuts it, so the window shrinks the longer he is allowed to land attacks on you.
audit.corrected: mid now carries the 16s and the fact that his hits shorten it.

edits.before: This is your window. Your E-stun into the delayed Q re-cast out-trades his poke, and your Adaptive Defense shield soaks one Lightslinger rotation every time it's up — so trade when it's charged and back off when it's on cooldown. At 6, Hextech Ultimatum answers everything he does: the arena traps him so he can't E-dash or Relentless-Pursuit out, and W's slow plus the heal off him keep you on top of him for the locked 1v1. Force the all-in while his E is down and never let him reset spacing.
edits.after: This is your window. Your E knock-up into the delayed Q re-cast out-trades his poke, and your Adaptive Defenses shield soaks one Lightslinger rotation every time it's up — so trade when it's charged and back off when it isn't. At 6, Hextech Ultimatum answers him: the arena traps him so Relentless Pursuit can't get him out, and W's slow plus the heal keep you on top for the locked 1v1. Force the all-in while that 16s dash is down, and stop feeding it — every Lightslinger hit shortens it.

edits.before: You don't fall off a cliff into Lucian the way you would a true scaler, but his first two crit/lethality items give him the range and double-dash mobility to skirmish from distance, so a face-up trade with your E on cooldown can get you Lightslinger-bursted down. Keep using R to drag him into an isolated 1v1 instead of letting him kite as a peeled carry, and look to close the game before his crit build fully comes online — your tempo and pick threat peak in the mid game while his power spikes at full items.

notes: 'His E dash and Relentless Pursuit' is written as two separate escapes in four places. They are the same ability, and the page reads as though Lucian has twice the disengage he owns, which changes whether you commit. The 'Galeforce-style' second dash in spikes[3] is an invented item mobility - the real and more useful fact is that Lightslinger attacks shorten Relentless Pursuit, so his dash uptime is a function of how much he is allowed to hit you. The nastiest omission: Lightslinger arms when a nearby enemy champion is IMMOBILIZED, so Camille's own Hookshot knock-up gives him the empowered double-shots on the way in. That is why the passive shield timing in this matchup is not optional. _missing-interactions.json also claims Lucian can cancel The Hextech Ultimatum with Lightslinger - that is a passive attack modifier with no CC attached, so I did not write it; it looks like a false positive off camille.json's misfiring 'channel' flag on R. Logged as unverified.
